info.name: DigiWMS Orang 1 — QA CRUD API Testing
info.description: HANYA server disposable tests/postman/run.ts. Port 5000 Production ditolak. Mulai dari request 01.00. Tidak ada migrasi atau koneksi MQTT.

exec: // Safe even on runtimes lacking skipRequest: fail closed by replacing the URL first.

function deny(message){pm.request.url.update('http://127.0.0.1:1/QA-BLOCKED');pm.environment.set('qaFailed','true');pm.execution.setNextRequest(null);pm.test('QA safety guard: '+message,()=>{throw new Error(message);});if(pm.execution.skipRequest)pm.execution.skipRequest();throw new Error(message);}
if(!/^http:\/\/(127\.0\.0\.1|localhost):5001$/.test(base||''))deny('QA requires dedicated loopback port 5001; port 5000 is Production.');
if(pm.environment.get('qaFailed')==='true'||!pm.environment.get('qaRunId'))deny('Setup failed or run not started. Run the collection from 01.00.');
let h;try{h=res.json();}catch(e){return deny('Invalid QA health JSON.');}

if(!h.qa||h.qa.kind!=='digiwms-postman-disposable-pg'||h.qa.isolated!==true||h.qa.mqtt!=='spy'||!/^orang1_postman_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(h.qa.schema)||!h.qa.nonce)return deny('Target has no disposable PostgreSQL proof.');
const old=pm.environment.get('qaNonce');if(old&&old!==h.qa.nonce)return deny('QA process changed during run.');

item.name: 04.02 — Audit CANCEL dan data tidak dihapus

request.description: QA disposable PostgreSQL saja. Jalankan dari awal koleksi; assertion gagal menghentikan urutan.

exec: eq('UUID dipertahankan',d.id,V('grnIdCancel'));eq('Status sesuai capability',d.status,V('supportsExtendedStatus')==='true'?'DIBATALKAN':'MENUNGGU_VERIFIKASI');if(V('supportsExtendedStatus')==='true'){history('CANCEL','grn','grnIdCancel');T('Alasan dan snapshot CANCEL',()=>{const a=d.audit_history.find(x=>x.action==='CANCEL');pm.expect(a.reason).to.eql("QA Orang 1: pemeriksaan alasan dan riwayat");pm.expect(a.before_data.status).to.eql('MENUNGGU_VERIFIKASI');pm.expect(a.after_data.status).to.eql('DIBATALKAN');});}else eq('Tidak ada audit CANCEL palsu',d.audit_history.filter(x=>x.action==='CANCEL').length,0);

request.description: QA disposable PostgreSQL saja. Jalankan dari awal koleksi; assertion gagal menghentikan urutan.

exec: history('ENCODE_SIMULATION','tag','tagId');history('UPDATE','tag','tagId');eq('Tipe persisted',d.type,'ON_METAL');eq('Native persisted',d.tag_type,'On-Metal (Logam/Cairan)');eq('EPC tetap',d.epc,V('epc'));eq('Relasi tidak berubah',d.product_id,V('productIdLinked'));T('Snapshot tipe',()=>{const a=d.audit_history.find(x=>x.action==='UPDATE');pm.expect(a.before_data.tag_type).to.eql('Label Biasa (UHF)');pm.expect(a.after_data.tag_type).to.eql('On-Metal (Logam/Cairan)');});

item.name: 04.04 — Audit DEACTIVATE dan retensi EPC item

request.description: QA disposable PostgreSQL saja. Jalankan dari awal koleksi; assertion gagal menghentikan urutan.

exec: eq('EPC retained',d.epc,V('epcDeactivate'));id('Item masih ada',d.item_id);eq('Status',d.status,V('supportsExtendedStatus')==='true'?'DAMAGED':'ENCODED');if(V('supportsExtendedStatus')==='true'){history('DEACTIVATE','tag','tagIdDeactivate');T('Alasan dan snapshot DEACTIVATE',()=>{const a=d.audit_history.find(x=>x.action==='DEACTIVATE');pm.expect(a.reason).to.eql("QA Orang 1: pemeriksaan alasan dan riwayat");pm.expect(a.before_data.status).to.eql('ENCODED');pm.expect(a.after_data.status).to.eql('DAMAGED');});}else eq('Tidak ada audit DEACTIVATE palsu',d.audit_history.filter(x=>x.action==='DEACTIVATE').length,0);
